decisions.label: Figure 1
decisions.caption: EUREKA generates human-level reward functions across diverse robots and tasks. Combined with curriculum learning, EUREKA for the first time, unlocks rapid pen-spinning capabilities on an anthropomorphic five-finger hand.
decisions.reason: 作为全篇论文的题头总览图，直观展示了跨越10种形态机器人的奖励设计能力以及高难度灵巧手转笔的突破，适合置于研究问题部分引出核心痛点。

decisions.label: Figure 2
decisions.caption: EUREKA takes unmodified environment source code and language task description as context to zero-shot generate executable reward functions from a coding LLM. Then, it iterates between reward sampling, GPU-accelerated reward evaluation, and reward reflection to progressively improve its reward outputs.
decisions.reason: 完整概述了 EUREKA 系统算法闭环（Environment as Context -> Zero-Shot Generation -> GPU Evaluation -> Reward Reflection -> Evolutionary Search），是方法主线机制流程最核心的示意图。

decisions.label: Figure 3
decisions.caption: EUREKA can zero-shot generate executable rewards and then flexibly improve them with many distinct types of free-form modification, such as (1) changing the hyperparameter of existing reward components, (2) changing the functional form of existing reward components, and (3) introducing new reward components.
decisions.reason: 具象化展示了自由形式代码修改的三种核心变异形式（修改超参数、修改函数数学形式、引入新状态组件），能够直观解释为什么代码表示比受限模板更具表达力。

decisions.label: Figure 4
decisions.caption: EUREKA outperforms Human and L2R across all tasks. In particular, EUREKA realizes much greater gains on high-dimensional dexterity environments.
decisions.reason: 承载全篇核心定量对比柱状图，直观反映 EUREKA、Human 与 L2R 在 Isaac 标准任务和 Dexterity 高维双灵巧手任务上的巨大性能差距。

decisions.label: Figure 5
decisions.caption: EUREKA progressively produces better rewards via in-context evolutionary reward search.
decisions.reason: 展示随着演化代数（Iteration 1 到 5）性能的稳步爬升，并与仅首代采样 32 个候选的无进化消融进行对比，证明演化机制的不可替代性。

decisions.label: Figure 6
decisions.caption: Eureka generates novel rewards. Scatter plot of human normalized score versus Pearson correlation between Eureka and human rewards.
decisions.reason: 揭示了 EUREKA 生成奖励的核心独特性：大部分高性能奖励与人类设计弱相关甚至负相关，打破人类直觉假设，是深度分析的强有力证据。

decisions.label: Figure 7
decisions.caption: EUREKA can be flexibly combined with curriculum learning to acquire complex dexterous skills.
decisions.reason: 展现灵巧手转笔任务中课程学习曲线（预训练、从零学习与微调），直接证明高动态长程任务需要分阶段课程引导。

decisions.label: Figure 8
decisions.caption: EUREKA effectively improves and benefits from human reward initialization.
decisions.reason: 展示人类初始奖励优化实验，表明无论人类基础奖励质量如何，EUREKA 均能在此基础上进一步提升性能，验证了人机协同助理价值。

decisions.label: Figure 9
decisions.caption: EUREKA can incorporate human reward reflection to modify rewards that induce safer and more human-aligned behavior.
decisions.reason: 呈现人类语言反馈引导 Humanoid 跑姿对齐的偏好评测表（15/20 偏好），证明无梯度上下文强化学习人类对齐（In-Context RLHF）的有效性。

decisions.caption: EUREKA reward functions enjoy improved sample efficiency compared to various baseline reward functions on aggregate over 20 Dexterity tasks.
decisions.reason: 附录 Dexterity 综合训练曲线，核心结论已在主结果文字中透彻阐明。

decisions.reason: 去奖励反思每任务消融柱状图，平均下降 28.6% 的关键数值已在正文中完整论述。

decisions.caption: Using GPT3.5 observes performance degradation in EUREKA but still remains comparable to GPT-4 on a majority of the tasks.
decisions.reason: GPT-3.5 消融对比图，已在正文消融部分详细解释底座模型降级对高维任务的影响。

decisions.label: Figure 16
decisions.caption: EUREKA rewards are less correlated with human rewards when the tasks are more high-dimensional and less common in the reinforcement learning literature.
decisions.reason: 任务维度与奖励相关性的趋势柱状图，已在相关性分析中深入讨论其机理。
